title: Shared Household Food Autoship Frequency when a Pet Moves to a Prescription Diet
content:
**Household feeding desk — re-timing a shared food subscription**

This rule sets the weeks between shipments of a non-prescription food Autoship under Tailwise Autoship that feeds more than one pet of the household, written as the subscription's frequency in weeks, when a pet that ate from it moves to a prescription diet and the subscription is re-timed for the pets that stay on it. The units per shipment stay as they are.

Re-timing is a frequency change to an existing subscription and sits within the Tailwise Autoship change rules for that subscription. The result is a frequency in whole weeks within the program's frequency range.

## Effect

Once re-timed for the pets that stay on it, the subscription's frequency becomes the number of weeks set, and every shipment after the upcoming one is scheduled that many weeks after the previous one. The units per shipment, the item and the already scheduled next ship date stay unchanged. The customer sees the new frequency right away.

## Recording the frequency: `set_shipment_interval_36e38cde`

**Capability.** Sets the delivery frequency, in weeks between shipments, of one existing non-prescription Autoship (Autoship Everyday, Autoship Litter & Bulk, Autoship Fresh & Frozen or Autoship Custom Meal Plan). The care agent performs it.

**How it is invoked.** The agent unlocks it with `unlock_agent_discoverable_tool` and calls `set_shipment_interval_36e38cde` through `call_agent_discoverable_tool`.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | What it is | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `autoship_id` | The reference number of the non-prescription Autoship subscription whose frequency is set, as the customer's Autoship subscriptions lookup shows it | Id |
| `frequency_weeks` | The number of weeks between shipments from now on | Integer, whole weeks, no decimals |

**Return.** A text rendering of a dictionary with `autoship_id` (the subscription reference number updated), `frequency_weeks` (the weeks between shipments now on the subscription) and `status`, always `updated` when the change was saved. A status of `updated` is the success receipt.
